events: text:plain:||Before Arrel remembered the dead beast, he remembered the sky opening.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_rim_omen.png
text:plain:||The Rim answered with teeth. A Void Beast descended through the ash, and the forest bent beneath it.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
choice:Say your name before the dark can take it.
text:plain:||Arrel. He spoke it once, then drove the name through the blade like a nail holding the world together.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_first_burn_strike.png
text:plain:||Arrel stood over the stain it left behind, sword still raised, though there was nothing left to cut.||
text:plain:||His skull throbbed. Not the clean pain of a headache but a deeper pressure, as if someone had scooped out a piece of his brain and left the cavity unsealed.||
text:plain:||He watched his own hand for a long moment before he recognized it.||res://assets/cg/generated/illustration_expansion_v2/world_rewrite_reaching_hand_v3.png
text:plain:||Her voice found him before her face did. Soft, close, and threaded with a fear she was trying not to spend.||
text:plain:||His right hand twitched. It moved toward her before he could stop it, fingers uncurling from the sword grip, reaching for something his muscles remembered but his mind did not.||
text:plain:||She did not step into the reach of the blade. She only lowered her lantern until the light caught the ash on his knuckles.||
text:plain:Arrel|One burn. Grade three, maybe. Nothing I'll miss.||arrel_default2|
text:plain:||That was probably true. That was probably a lie.||
text:plain:||The problem with burning memories was that you could never be sure which it was.||
text:plain:||A gray flake, lighter than dust, dissolving against his skin with a faint warmth that was not his own.||
text:plain:||It came down through the canopy in slow spirals, each flake carrying the residue of someone else's loss.||
text:plain:Arrel|Someone else's sorrow. Not mine. Not anymore.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:Elia|We should move. The rain will get thicker after dark.||elia_neutral|
text:plain:||The ash thickened. Between the trees, something moved in the gray, too many limbs, too little shape.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:Arrel|They can smell warmth. Heat. Living things.||arrel_determined|
text:plain:Elia|We can't outrun them. Not at this pace.||elia_concern|
text:plain:||A memory surfaced, unbidden. A song his mother used to hum by a campfire. Warm. Specific. His.||
text:plain:||He could burn it. Let the warmth of it spread into the ash and confuse the things that tracked him.||

text:plain:||He let the melody catch. For one breath, the forest smelled of smoke and old wood. Then the song was heat, then ash, then nothing.||res://assets/cg/generated/illustration_expansion_v2/world_rewrite_campfire_song_v3.png
text:distorted:||After a while she began to hum. He waited for the melody to mean something. It didn't.||res://assets/cg/generated/archive_ch1_camp_humming_v2.png
text:distorted:Arrel|...Is that a song? It sounds like one. I can't tell.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:||Morning would come. The Belt waited ahead. And somewhere beyond it, the answers he was trading himself to find.||
text:plain:||At dawn, the ash had thickened into a fine carpet over everything.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_twisted_forest_path.png
text:plain:Elia|There's movement ahead. More of them. We can go around, or through.||elia_determined|
text:plain:Arrel|Through. Lose the trail, lose days.||arrel_determined|
text:plain:||Morning came thin and grey. The ash had stopped sometime in the dark, and the forest looked, almost, like a forest again.||ch1_twisted_forest
text:plain:||Almost. The trees still leaned toward something he could not see. The path under his boots remembered other footsteps.||
text:plain:Elia|Bureau patrols start at noon. We have until then.||elia_neutral|
text:plain:||He looked at the clearing. Three things in his memory pulled at him before the fourth, the path forward.||
text:plain:||A tree stump, old enough that its rings had turned to stone.||ch1_stump2
text:plain:||Someone had carved letters into it once. The rain had eaten most of them, but two remained: A. E.||
text:plain:||His hand moved toward the carving before he could stop it.||
text:plain:||But his fingers traced the grooves one more time before he pulled away.||
text:plain:||The path narrowed. The trees pressed closer.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||Something had been here. The ground was wrong, patches of moss bleached white, bark stripped in long parallel grooves.||
text:plain:||Ahead, where the canopy opened, something exhaled.||
text:plain:||Not breath. Something that wanted to be breath but had forgotten how.||
text:plain:Elia|It's between us and the road. We can't go around.||elia_determined|
text:plain:||He drew his sword. The grip remembered his hand, even when he did not always remember the grip.||
text:plain:||It uncoiled from the canopy like something the forest had been hiding from itself.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||Too many limbs. Too few joints. A throat that opened the wrong way.||
text:plain:Elia|It's hollow. There's no person left in it. You can hit it as hard as you need to.||elia_determined|
text:plain:||He stepped in. The blade went where it always went, clean, efficient, taught long ago by hands he could no longer name.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||The thing screamed without using its mouth.||
text:plain:||A grey limb whipped down where his head had been a moment before. He felt the pressure of it as much as he saw it.||
text:plain:Elia|It's faster than the last one!||elia_concern|
text:plain:||First wound: shallow. Survival, not victory.||
text:plain:||But it was bleeding now, if grey smoke pouring out of a wound counted as bleeding.||
text:plain:||The beast did not die from one wound. It *learned* from it.||res://assets/cg/generated/cinematic_void_beast_memory_devour.png
text:plain:||It widened. The hollow at its center opened, and from inside, more grey, older grey, the kind that smelled like other people's losses.||
text:plain:||He moved faster than was wise. The beast's limb caught his shoulder, and pain bloomed bright and clean.||res://assets/cg/generated/cinematic_void_beast_memory_devour.png
text:plain:||But the blade was already through it. Through it. Through it.||
text:plain:Arrel|...How much does it have left?||arrel_burn|

text:plain:||What remained of the beast collapsed into a stain of grey ash that the wind took, slowly, like the wind was trying to be respectful about it.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_opening_aftermath.png
text:plain:||He stood over it, breathing harder than he wanted Elia to see.||
text:plain:Elia|You're hurt. And you burned for it.||elia_concern|
text:plain:Elia|I just want to know what was worth it.||elia_sad|
text:plain:Arrel|Standing here. With you. Worth it.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:||She looked at him a long moment. Then she turned, and they walked on.||
text:plain:||The forest thinned. The air cleared, or rather, it replaced one kind of thickness with another.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_twisted_forest_path.png
text:plain:Elia|You fought through that without burning anything else.||elia_concern|
text:plain:||A single tree, still green, stood at the edge of the clearing like a joke the world had forgotten to finish.||ch1_green_tree
text:plain:||Elia stopped. Her hand went to the bark, fingers spread against the living wood as if checking whether it would answer.||
text:plain:||Beyond the treeline, far to the south, the Bureau's tower scraped at the clouds like a finger pointing out an accusation.||res://assets/cg/game_image/sealed_city_ruins.png
text:plain:||That was where the answers were. That was where he would have to go.||
text:plain:||But first, the Belt. And the man who might know whether his brother was still alive.||
text:plain:||Verdan Market, the Belt's largest trading hub, and the Bureau's most tolerated black eye.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_verdan_gate.png
text:plain:||It sprawled across three old canyons, stitched together with rope-bridges and smoke and the low hum of too many voices at once.||
text:plain:||Somewhere down there, Malet kept a desk. And Malet, if rumor held, kept debts, including whatever was owed to the name Arrel no longer wanted to say aloud.||
text:plain:Arrel|I'll stay close. You keep your hood up.||arrel_neutral|
text:plain:Arrel|Worried about what someone might recognize.||arrel_pensive|
text:plain:||Below them, the market opened its mouth.||
text:plain:||A guard stopped them at the southern stairs. Bureau insignia. Too alert for a Belt posting.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_verdan_gate.png
text:plain:Guard|Names. Purpose. Papers if you have them.|||
choice:Tell him we're hunters tracking rogue Husks.
text:plain:||Either way, the market swallowed them whole.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_memory_market.png

text:plain:||It sprawled across three old canyons, stitched together with rope-bridges and smoke and the low hum of too many voices at once.||
text:plain:||Somewhere down there, Malet kept a desk. And Malet, if rumor held, kept debts, including whatever was owed to the name Arrel no longer wanted to say aloud.||
text:plain:Arrel|I'll stay close. You keep your hood up.||arrel_neutral|
text:plain:Arrel|Worried about what someone might recognize.||arrel_pensive|
text:plain:||Below them, the market opened its mouth.||
text:plain:||A guard stopped them at the southern stairs. Bureau insignia. Too alert for a Belt posting.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_verdan_gate.png
text:plain:Guard|Names. Purpose. Papers if you have them.|||
text:plain:||Either way, the market swallowed them whole.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_memory_market.png
text:plain:||Before Arrel remembered the dead beast, he remembered the sky opening.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_rim_omen.png
text:plain:||The Rim answered with teeth. A Void Beast descended through the ash, and the forest bent beneath it.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
choice:Say your name before the dark can take it.
text:plain:||Arrel. He spoke it once, then drove the name through the blade like a nail holding the world together.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_first_burn_strike.png
text:plain:||Arrel stood over the stain it left behind, sword still raised, though there was nothing left to cut.||
text:plain:||His skull throbbed. Not the clean pain of a headache but a deeper pressure, as if someone had scooped out a piece of his brain and left the cavity unsealed.||
text:plain:||He watched his own hand for a long moment before he recognized it.||res://assets/cg/generated/illustration_expansion_v2/world_rewrite_reaching_hand_v3.png
text:plain:||Her voice found him before her face did. Soft, close, and threaded with a fear she was trying not to spend.||
text:plain:||His right hand twitched. It moved toward her before he could stop it, fingers uncurling from the sword grip, reaching for something his muscles remembered but his mind did not.||
text:plain:||She did not step into the reach of the blade. She only lowered her lantern until the light caught the ash on his knuckles.||
text:plain:Arrel|One burn. Grade three, maybe. Nothing I'll miss.||arrel_default2|
text:plain:||That was probably true. That was probably a lie.||
text:plain:||The problem with burning memories was that you could never be sure which it was.||
text:plain:||A gray flake, lighter than dust, dissolving against his skin with a faint warmth that was not his own.||
text:plain:||It came down through the canopy in slow spirals, each flake carrying the residue of someone else's loss.||
text:plain:Arrel|Someone else's sorrow. Not mine. Not anymore.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:Elia|We should move. The rain will get thicker after dark.||elia_neutral|
text:plain:||The ash thickened. Between the trees, something moved in the gray, too many limbs, too little shape.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:Arrel|They can smell warmth. Heat. Living things.||arrel_determined|
text:plain:Elia|We can't outrun them. Not at this pace.||elia_concern|
text:plain:||A memory surfaced, unbidden. A song his mother used to hum by a campfire. Warm. Specific. His.||
text:plain:||He could burn it. Let the warmth of it spread into the ash and confuse the things that tracked him.||

text:plain:||He let the melody catch. For one breath, the forest smelled of smoke and old wood. Then the song was heat, then ash, then nothing.||res://assets/cg/generated/illustration_expansion_v2/world_rewrite_campfire_song_v3.png
choice:Try to remember what you burned.
text:distorted:||After a while she began to hum. He waited for the melody to mean something. It didn't.||res://assets/cg/generated/archive_ch1_camp_humming_v2.png
text:distorted:Arrel|...Is that a song? It sounds like one. I can't tell.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:||Morning would come. The Belt waited ahead. And somewhere beyond it, the answers he was trading himself to find.||
text:plain:||At dawn, the ash had thickened into a fine carpet over everything.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_twisted_forest_path.png
text:plain:Elia|There's movement ahead. More of them. We can go around, or through.||elia_determined|
text:plain:Arrel|Through. Lose the trail, lose days.||arrel_determined|
text:plain:||Morning came thin and grey. The ash had stopped sometime in the dark, and the forest looked, almost, like a forest again.||ch1_twisted_forest
text:plain:||Almost. The trees still leaned toward something he could not see. The path under his boots remembered other footsteps.||
text:plain:Elia|Bureau patrols start at noon. We have until then.||elia_neutral|
text:plain:||He looked at the clearing. Three things in his memory pulled at him before the fourth, the path forward.||
text:plain:||Elia waited where the path forked, hands loose at her sides, watching him in that careful way she had.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_elia_reunion.png
text:plain:||He didn't answer. She did not push.||
text:distorted:Elia|Whatever happens out there, try not to burn the rest of yourself.||elia_sad|
text:plain:||She nodded, once, and looked away.||
text:plain:||The path narrowed. The trees pressed closer.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||Something had been here. The ground was wrong, patches of moss bleached white, bark stripped in long parallel grooves.||
text:plain:||Ahead, where the canopy opened, something exhaled.||
text:plain:||Not breath. Something that wanted to be breath but had forgotten how.||
text:plain:Elia|It's between us and the road. We can't go around.||elia_determined|
text:plain:||He drew his sword. The grip remembered his hand, even when he did not always remember the grip.||
text:plain:||It uncoiled from the canopy like something the forest had been hiding from itself.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||Too many limbs. Too few joints. A throat that opened the wrong way.||
text:plain:Elia|It's hollow. There's no person left in it. You can hit it as hard as you need to.||elia_determined|
text:plain:||He held the blade low and let it come.||
text:plain:||The thing moved in waves, limbs not striking but *flowing*, looking for a way through his guard.||
text:plain:||He saw the pattern. Three sweeps high, one low. A rhythm older than the creature, older than the forest.||
text:plain:||When the low strike came, he stepped through it and put the sword between two of its ribs.||
text:plain:||It was. The beast retreated, smoke leaking, cautious now.||
text:plain:||The beast did not die from one wound. It *learned* from it.||res://assets/cg/generated/cinematic_void_beast_memory_devour.png
text:plain:||It widened. The hollow at its center opened, and from inside, more grey, older grey, the kind that smelled like other people's losses.||
choice:Use what you read. Counter its rhythm.
text:plain:||He moved as he had read the beast move, not against its rhythm, but *with* it.||
text:plain:||When its limb came high, he was already low. When the low strike opened, he was already past it.||
text:plain:||The killing cut went where the rhythm wanted it to go, and the beast had no answer.||
text:plain:Arrel|It didn't have one to learn.||arrel_pensive|

text:plain:||What remained of the beast collapsed into a stain of grey ash that the wind took, slowly, like the wind was trying to be respectful about it.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_opening_aftermath.png
text:plain:||He stood over it, breathing harder than he wanted Elia to see.||
text:plain:Elia|You're hurt. And you burned for it.||elia_concern|
text:plain:Elia|I just want to know what was worth it.||elia_sad|
text:plain:Arrel|Standing here. With you. Worth it.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:||She looked at him a long moment. Then she turned, and they walked on.||
text:plain:||The forest thinned. The air cleared, or rather, it replaced one kind of thickness with another.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_twisted_forest_path.png
text:plain:Elia|You fought through that without burning anything else.||elia_concern|
text:plain:||A single tree, still green, stood at the edge of the clearing like a joke the world had forgotten to finish.||ch1_green_tree
text:plain:||Elia stopped. Her hand went to the bark, fingers spread against the living wood as if checking whether it would answer.||
text:plain:||Beyond the treeline, far to the south, the Bureau's tower scraped at the clouds like a finger pointing out an accusation.||res://assets/cg/game_image/sealed_city_ruins.png
text:plain:||That was where the answers were. That was where he would have to go.||
text:plain:||But first, the Belt. And the man who might know whether his brother was still alive.||
text:plain:||Verdan Market, the Belt's largest trading hub, and the Bureau's most tolerated black eye.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_verdan_gate.png
text:plain:||It sprawled across three old canyons, stitched together with rope-bridges and smoke and the low hum of too many voices at once.||
text:plain:||Somewhere down there, Malet kept a desk. And Malet, if rumor held, kept debts, including whatever was owed to the name Arrel no longer wanted to say aloud.||
text:plain:Arrel|I'll stay close. You keep your hood up.||arrel_neutral|
text:plain:Arrel|Worried about what someone might recognize.||arrel_pensive|
text:plain:||Below them, the market opened its mouth.||
text:plain:||A guard stopped them at the southern stairs. Bureau insignia. Too alert for a Belt posting.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_verdan_gate.png
text:plain:Guard|Names. Purpose. Papers if you have them.|||
choice:Tell him we're hunters tracking rogue Husks.
text:plain:||Either way, the market swallowed them whole.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_memory_market.png
text:plain:||아렐은 죽은 괴물보다 먼저, 하늘이 열리던 순간을 기억했다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_rim_omen.png
text:plain:||림은 이빨로 대답했다. 보이드 비스트가 재를 가르며 내려왔고, 숲 전체가 그 아래에서 휘었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
choice:어둠이 빼앗기 전에 자신의 이름을 말한다.
text:plain:||아렐. 그는 이름을 한 번 입에 올리고, 세계를 붙드는 못처럼 칼날에 박아 넣었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_first_burn_strike.png
text:plain:||아렐은 그것이 남긴 얼룩 앞에 서 있었다. 검은 아직 치켜든 채였지만, 더 이상 벨 것은 없었다.||
text:plain:||두개골이 욱신거렸다. 깨끗한 두통이 아니라, 뇌의 한 조각을 도려낸 뒤 그 빈자리를 봉합하지 않은 듯한 깊은 압박이었다.||
text:plain:||그는 한참 동안 자기 손을 바라본 뒤에야 그것이 자신의 손이라는 걸 알아보았다.||res://assets/cg/generated/illustration_expansion_v2/world_rewrite_reaching_hand_v3.png
text:plain:||그녀의 목소리가 얼굴보다 먼저 그를 찾아왔다. 부드럽고, 가까웠고, 쓰지 않으려 애쓰는 두려움이 섞여 있었다.||
text:plain:Elia|좋아. 그 정도는 아직 남아 있네.||elia_gentle_smile|
text:plain:||오른손이 움찔했다. 멈추기도 전에 그녀를 향해 움직였고, 검 손잡이를 쥔 손가락이 풀리며 머리는 잊었지만 근육은 기억하는 무언가를 향해 뻗었다.||
text:plain:||그녀는 칼날의 사정거리 안으로 들어오지 않았다. 대신 등불을 낮춰, 그의 손마디에 묻은 재가 빛에 드러나게 했다.||
text:plain:Arrel|한 번 태웠어. 3등급쯤. 없어져도 아깝지 않은 거야.||arrel_default2|
text:plain:||기억을 태우는 일의 문제는, 어느 쪽인지 절대 확신할 수 없다는 데 있었다.||
text:plain:||먼지보다 가벼운 회색 조각 하나가 피부 위에서 녹아들었다. 희미한 온기가 있었지만, 그의 것은 아니었다.||
text:plain:||재는 나무 사이로 느린 나선처럼 떨어졌다. 조각마다 누군가가 잃어버린 것의 잔재를 품고 있었다.||
text:plain:Arrel|다른 누군가의 슬픔. 내 것이 아니야. 이제는.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:Elia|움직여야 해. 해가 지면 비가 더 짙어질 거야.||elia_neutral|
text:plain:||재가 짙어졌다. 나무들 사이, 회색 속에서 무언가가 움직였다. 팔다리는 너무 많고, 형체는 너무 적었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:Arrel|놈들은 온기를 맡아. 열. 살아 있는 것들.||arrel_determined|
text:plain:||기억 하나가 불쑥 떠올랐다. 어머니가 모닥불 곁에서 흥얼거리던 노래. 따뜻하고, 또렷하고, 그의 것이었다.||
text:plain:||그는 그것을 태울 수 있었다. 그 온기를 재 속으로 퍼뜨려, 자신을 추적하는 것들을 혼란스럽게 만들 수 있었다.||
text:plain:||그는 선율에 불을 붙였다. 한 호흡 동안 숲은 연기와 오래된 장작 냄새로 가득했다. 그리고 노래는 열이 되었고, 재가 되었고, 아무것도 아니게 되었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/illustration_expansion_v2/world_rewrite_campfire_song_v3.png
text:distorted:||잠시 후 그녀가 흥얼거리기 시작했다. 그는 그 선율이 무언가를 뜻하길 기다렸다. 하지만 아무 의미도 없었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/archive_ch1_camp_humming_v2.png
text:distorted:Arrel|...그거 노래야? 노래 같긴 한데. 모르겠어.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:||아침은 올 것이다. 벨트가 앞에 기다리고 있었다. 그리고 그 너머 어딘가에, 그가 자기 자신과 맞바꾸며 찾는 답이 있었다.||
text:plain:||새벽이 되자 재는 모든 것 위에 고운 융단처럼 쌓여 있었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_twisted_forest_path.png
text:plain:Elia|앞쪽에 움직임이 있어. 더 많아. 돌아갈 수도 있고, 뚫고 갈 수도 있어.||elia_determined|
text:plain:Arrel|뚫고 간다. 지금 흔적을 놓치면 며칠을 잃어.||arrel_determined|
text:plain:||희고 얇은 아침이 왔다. 밤사이 어느 순간 재는 그쳤고, 숲은 거의 숲처럼 보였다.||ch1_twisted_forest
text:plain:||거의. 나무들은 아직 그가 볼 수 없는 무언가를 향해 기울어 있었고, 발밑의 길은 다른 발자국들을 기억하고 있었다.||
text:plain:Elia|관리국 순찰은 정오부터야. 그 전까지는 시간이 있어.||elia_neutral|
text:plain:||그는 공터를 바라보았다. 앞으로 이어진 길보다 먼저, 기억 속 세 가지가 그를 잡아당겼다.||
text:plain:||나이테가 돌처럼 굳어버릴 만큼 오래된 그루터기였다.||ch1_stump2
text:plain:||누군가 오래전에 글자를 새겨두었다. 비가 대부분을 먹어치웠지만 두 글자는 남아 있었다. A. E.||
text:plain:||멈추기도 전에 그의 손이 새겨진 홈을 향해 움직였다.||
text:plain:||하지만 그는 손을 떼기 전, 한 번 더 손끝으로 홈을 더듬었다.||
text:plain:||무언가가 이곳에 있었다. 땅이 이상했다. 이끼는 군데군데 하얗게 바랬고, 나무껍질은 길고 평행한 홈으로 벗겨져 있었다.||
text:plain:||앞쪽, 나뭇잎 사이가 열린 곳에서 무언가가 숨을 내쉬었다.||
text:plain:||숨은 아니었다. 숨이고 싶었지만 방법을 잊어버린 무언가였다.||
text:plain:Elia|저게 우리와 길 사이에 있어. 돌아갈 수 없어.||elia_determined|
text:plain:||그는 검을 뽑았다. 그가 손잡이를 늘 기억하는 것은 아니었지만, 손잡이는 그의 손을 기억하고 있었다.||
text:plain:||그것은 숲이 스스로에게서 숨겨왔던 것처럼 나뭇잎 사이에서 몸을 풀며 내려왔다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||팔다리는 너무 많고, 관절은 너무 적었다. 목구멍은 잘못된 방향으로 벌어졌다.||
text:plain:Elia|속이 비었어. 저 안에는 더 이상 사람이 남아 있지 않아. 필요한 만큼 세게 쳐도 돼.||elia_determined|
text:plain:||그는 파고들었다. 칼날은 늘 가던 곳으로 갔다. 깔끔하고, 효율적이고, 이제는 이름도 떠올릴 수 없는 손들이 오래전에 가르쳐준 궤적이었다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_void_beast_emergence.png
text:plain:||그것은 입을 쓰지 않고 비명을 질렀다.||
text:plain:||회색 팔다리 하나가 방금 전 그의 머리가 있던 자리를 후려쳤다. 그는 그것을 보는 만큼이나 압력으로 느꼈다.||
text:plain:||첫 상처는 얕았다. 승리가 아니라 생존이었다.||
text:plain:||그래도 이제 피를 흘리고 있었다. 상처에서 회색 연기가 쏟아지는 것을 피라고 부를 수 있다면.||
text:plain:||괴물은 상처 하나로 죽지 않았다. 그것은 그 상처에서 배웠다.||res://assets/cg/generated/cinematic_void_beast_memory_devour.png
text:plain:||몸이 벌어졌다. 중심의 빈 구멍이 열리고, 안쪽에서 더 많은 회색이 흘러나왔다. 더 오래된 회색, 타인의 상실 냄새가 나는 회색이었다.||
text:plain:||그는 지나치게 빠르게 움직였다. 괴물의 팔다리가 어깨를 스쳤고, 선명하고 깨끗한 통증이 피어났다.||res://assets/cg/generated/cinematic_void_beast_memory_devour.png
text:plain:||하지만 칼날은 이미 놈을 관통하고 있었다. 한 번. 또 한 번. 또 한 번.||
text:plain:||괴물의 잔해는 회색 재의 얼룩으로 무너졌다. 바람은 마치 예의를 갖추려는 듯 그것을 천천히 데려갔다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_opening_aftermath.png
text:plain:||그는 그 앞에 서서 숨을 몰아쉬었다. 엘리아에게 보이고 싶은 것보다 훨씬 거칠게.||
text:plain:Elia|뭐가 그만한 가치가 있었는지 알고 싶을 뿐이야.||elia_sad|
text:plain:Arrel|여기 서 있는 것. 너와 말하고 있는 것. 그만한 가치가 있었어.||arrel_cold|
text:plain:||그녀는 한참 동안 그를 바라보았다. 그리고 몸을 돌렸고, 둘은 다시 걸었다.||
text:plain:||숲이 얇아졌습니다. 공기가 맑아졌습니다. 오히려 한 종류의 두께를 다른 두께로 대체했습니다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch1_twisted_forest_path.png
text:plain:Elia|당신은 다른 것을 태우지 않고 그것을 극복했습니다.||elia_concern|
text:plain:||세상이 끝내는 것을 잊어버린 농담처럼 공터 가장자리에 아직 녹색인 나무 한 그루가 서 있었습니다.||ch1_green_tree
text:plain:||엘리아는 멈춰섰다. 그녀의 손은 나무껍질로 향했고, 마치 그것이 응답할지 확인하려는 듯 손가락을 살아있는 나무에 대고 펼쳤습니다.||
text:plain:||수목한계 너머, 멀리 남쪽에는 국의 탑이 비난을 가리키는 손가락처럼 구름을 긁어냈다.||res://assets/cg/game_image/sealed_city_ruins.png
text:plain:||거기에 답이 있었습니다. 그가 가야 할 곳은 바로 그곳이었다.||
text:plain:||하지만 먼저, 벨트. 그리고 형이 아직 살아 있는지 알 수도 있는 남자.||
text:plain:||베르단 시장(베르단 Market), 벨트의 가장 큰 거래 허브이자 관리국에서 가장 용인되는 검은 눈입니다.||res://assets/cg/generated/story_ch2_verdan_gate.png
text:plain:||그것은 세 개의 오래된 협곡을 가로질러 펼쳐져 있었고, 밧줄 다리와 연기, 동시에 너무 많은 목소리의 낮은 웅웅거림이 얽혀 있었습니다.||
text:plain:||저 아래 어딘가에 말렛는 책상을 보관했습니다. 그리고 말렛는 소문이 사실이라면 아렐이라는 이름에 빚진 모든 것을 포함하여 더 이상 큰 소리로 말하고 싶지 않은 빚을 유지했습니다.||
text:plain:Arrel|나는 가까이 있을 것이다. 당신은 후드를 유지합니다.||arrel_neutral|
